taskDetails.createProject:
Link projects to a folder or repo, and that context is there in every chat.

Chats, files, and history stay together, not scattered across sessions.
taskDetails.addWidget:

1.title: Your canvas, your home
1.body: Pin what matters, find it fast. Home is where you keep the stuff you don't want to dig for — pin a chat, an agent, a widget.
1.visual: A preview of the Berd home canvas

2.title: All your AI providers in one place
2.body: Whichever provider you use, you can chat with it here. Connect more than one and switch between them anytime, even mid-chat.
2.visual: A collection of AI provider icons

3.title: Ask Berd anything
3.body: Ask questions, explore ideas, or work through a task. Berd keeps the context so you can keep going.

4.title: Agents have joined the chat
4.body: An agent is a specialist you talk to directly. @mention one in a chat and it works with you like a teammate, not a tool.

5.title: Teach Berd a new trick with skills
5.body: Skills give Berd and your agents instructions for a specific task, tool, or workflow, so you don't have to spell it out every time.
5.visual: A collection of reusable Berd skills
